headline: Shah Metacorp appoints Shivam Soni & Co. as auditors
summary: Shah Metacorp Limited has informed the stock exchange about the appointment of M/s. Shivam Soni & Co., Chartered Accountants, to a company role effective September 30, 2026. This routine corporate governance update involves a change in the firm's auditing or financial oversight personnel. Indian retail investors holding the stock should note the administrative transition, though it carries no immediate financial impact. Regular auditor appointments are standard procedural filings required by listed entities.
why_it_matters: Routine administrative update with no immediate financial impact for shareholders.

headline: Shah Metacorp submits AGM voting results and scrutinizer report
summary: Shah Metacorp Limited has concluded its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The company has officially submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results to the stock exchange. Such procedural disclosures are standard compliance for listed entities following their annual shareholder meetings. Retail investors holding shares in micro-cap companies like Shah Metacorp should note this as routine administrative compliance with no direct financial impact.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate compliance with no financial impact.
